40017199.author: पदार्थः
40017199.content: महातेजाः highly energetic, ब्रह्मदत्तवरः who had obtained boons from Brahma, अद्रिसङ्काशः mountain like form, युधि in battle, देवदानवदर्पहा who subdued the pride of Devas and Danavas, अतिकायः of huge body, तुमुलम् making a tumultuous sound, रोमहर्षणम् horripilation, स्वबलम् his own army, व्यथितम् killed, दृष्टवा seeing, शक्रतुल्यपराक्रमान् equal to Indra in valour, भ्रातृ़न् च brothers, निहतान् killed, दृष्टवा seeing, पितृव्वौ uncles, राक्षसर्षभौ bulls among Rakshasas, भ्रातरौ brothers, युद्धोन्मतं च Yuddhomatta, मत्तं च Matta, समरे in conflict, सन्निघादितौ collected together, सन्द्दृश्य seeing, चुकोप च was furious.

40017199.author: Translation
40017199.content: Highly energetic Atikaya, who was like a mountain in form, had huge body, obtained boons from Brahma, subdued the pride of Devas and Danavas, was equal to Indra in valour. Seeing his own army of Rakshasas that caused horripilation, uncles who were bulls among Rakshasas struck down in the battlefield and his own brothers Yuddhotama (Mahodara) and Matta (Mahaparsva) struck down, he flew in rage.

40017200.content: महातेजाः highly energetic, ब्रह्मदत्तवरः who had obtained boons from Brahma, अद्रिसङ्काशः mountain like form, युधि in battle, देवदानवदर्पहा who subdued the pride of Devas and Danavas, अतिकायः of huge body, तुमुलम् making a tumultuous sound, रोमहर्षणम् horripilation, स्वबलम् his own army, व्यथितम् killed, दृष्टवा seeing, शक्रतुल्यपराक्रमान् equal to Indra in valour, भ्रातृ़न् च brothers, निहतान् killed, दृष्टवा seeing, पितृव्वौ uncles, राक्षसर्षभौ bulls among Rakshasas, भ्रातरौ brothers, युद्धोन्मतं च Yuddhomatta, मत्तं च Matta, समरे in conflict, सन्निघादितौ collected together, सन्द्दृश्य seeing, चुकोप च was furious.

40017200.author: Translation
40017200.content: Highly energetic Atikaya, who was like a mountain in form, had huge body, obtained boons from Brahma, subdued the pride of Devas and Danavas, was equal to Indra in valour. Seeing his own army of Rakshasas that caused horripilation, uncles who were bulls among Rakshasas struck down in the battlefield and his own brothers Yuddhotama (Mahodara) and Matta (Mahaparsva) struck down, he flew in rage.

40017200.author: सारांशः
40017200.content: Atikaya, son of Dhanyamalini, arrives on the battlefield. Vanaras and Rama wondered at his form, chariot, and brilliance. Lakshmana has a terrific fight with Atikaya and kills him.

40017201.author: पदार्थः
40017201.content: महातेजाः highly energetic, ब्रह्मदत्तवरः who had obtained boons from Brahma, अद्रिसङ्काशः mountain like form, युधि in battle, देवदानवदर्पहा who subdued the pride of Devas and Danavas, अतिकायः of huge body, तुमुलम् making a tumultuous sound, रोमहर्षणम् horripilation, स्वबलम् his own army, व्यथितम् killed, दृष्टवा seeing, शक्रतुल्यपराक्रमान् equal to Indra in valour, भ्रातृ़न् च brothers, निहतान् killed, दृष्टवा seeing, पितृव्वौ uncles, राक्षसर्षभौ bulls among Rakshasas, भ्रातरौ brothers, युद्धोन्मतं च Yuddhomatta, मत्तं च Matta, समरे in conflict, सन्निघादितौ collected together, सन्द्दृश्य seeing, चुकोप च was furious.

40017201.author: Translation
40017201.content: Highly energetic Atikaya, who was like a mountain in form, had huge body, obtained boons from Brahma, subdued the pride of Devas and Danavas, was equal to Indra in valour. Seeing his own army of Rakshasas that caused horripilation, uncles who were bulls among Rakshasas struck down in the battlefield and his own brothers Yuddhotama (Mahodara) and Matta (Mahaparsva) struck down, he flew in rage.

40017201.author: सारांशः
40017201.content: Atikaya, son of Dhanyamalini, arrives on the battlefield. Vanaras and Rama wondered at his form, chariot, and brilliance. Lakshmana has a terrific fight with Atikaya and kills him.

40017202.author: पदार्थः
40017202.content: शक्रारिः crowned, सः he, भासरसहस्रस्य thousand suns, सङ्घातमिव collected, भास्वरम् glowing, रथम् chariot, आस्थाय mounted, वानरान् Vanaras, अभिदुद्राव darted towards.

40017202.author: Translation
40017202.content: Adorned with a crown, Ravana glowing like a thousand suns collected together mounted the chariot and darted towards Vanaras.

40017203.author: पदार्थः
40017203.content: किरीटी adorned with crown, मृष्टकुण्डलः polished earrings, सः he, महा great, चापम् bow, विस्फार्य twanging,नाम name, विश्रावयामास proclaimed, महास्वनम् sounding aloud, ननाद च roared.

40017203.author: Translation
40017203.content: Adorned with crown, and polished earrings, twanging his bow, proclaimed his name and roared sounding aloud.

40017204.author: पदार्थः
40017204.content: तेन by that, सिंहप्रणादेन lion roar, नामविश्रावणेन च proclamation of his name, भीमेन frightening, ज्याशब्देन च by that sound, वानरान् Vanaras, त्रासयामास struck terror.

40017204.author: Translation
40017204.content: By that lionroar, and proclamation of his name (by the sound of the twang) frightening the Vanaras he struck terror.

40017205.author: पदार्थः
40017205.content: सर्वे all, तेवानराः those Vanaras, देहमाहात्म्यं huge body, दृष्टवा seeing, अयम् this, कुम्भकर्णः Kumbhakarna, उथतितः got up and come, भयार्ताः in fear, परस्परम् one another, संश्रयन्ते sought help.

40017205.author: Translation
40017205.content: Those Vanaras seeing the huge body thought, "This is Kumbhakarna, who has got up and come'. Out of fear, they sought the help of one another.

40017206.author: पदार्थः
40017206.content: ते they, वानरयूधाः Vanara troops, त्रिविक्रमे Trivikrama form assumed, विष्णोःयथा by Vishnu, तस्य his, रूपम् form, आलोक्य observing, भयात् in panic, ततस्ततः here and there, विद्रवन्ति fled in panic.

40017206.author: Translation
40017206.content: The Vanara troops, observing his form resembling the Trivikram form assumed by Vishnu, the monkey troops fled here and there in panic.

40017207.author: पदार्थः
40017207.content: तेवानराः those Vanaras, अतिकायम् huge body, समासाद्य reaching, मूढचेतसः deluded, आहवे sought, शरण्यम् refuge, लक्ष्मणाग्रजम् brother of Lakshmana, जग्मुः went.

40017207.author: Translation
40017207.content: The Vanaras were deluded on reaching the huge body and went to Sri Rama to seek refuge.

40017208.author: पदार्थः
40017208.content: ततः then, काकुत्थ्सः Kakutstha, रथस्थम् on the chariot, पर्वतोपमम् looking like mountain, धवनिन wielding bow, कालमेघवत् rumbling like cloud at the time of universal destruction, गर्जन्तम् roaring, अतिकायम् huge body, दूरात् from a distance, ददर्श saw.

40017208.author: Translation
40017208.content: Then Kakutstha saw from a distance form of huge body looking like a mountain, wielding bow, rumbling like a cloud at universal destruction.

40017209.author: पदार्थः
40017209.content: सः he, राघवस्तु Raghava, महात्मानं great self, तम् him, दृष्टवा seeing, विसिस्मिये. amazed, वानरान् Vanaras, सान्त्वयित्वा च reassuring, विभीषणम् to Vibheeshana, उवाच ह spoke.

40017209.author: Translation
40017209.content: Raghava the great, seeing the form of a huge body, was amazed, reassured by the Vanaras, and spoke to Vibheeshana.

40017210.author: पदार्थः
40017210.content: पर्वतसङ्काशः resembling mountain, धनुष्मान् holding a bow, हरिलोचनः yellow eyes, हयसहस्रेण by a thousand horses, युक्ते drawn, विशाले broad, स्यन्दने chariot, स्थितः seated, असौ is, कः who.

40017210.author: Translation
40017210.content: "Who is he, the yelloweyed, resembling a mountain, seated in the broad chariot drawn by a thousand horses?"

40017211.author: पदार्थः
40017211.content: यः he who, एषः that way, अर्चिष्मद्भिः in the midst, निशितैः sharp, शूलैः tridents, सुतीक्णैः shining, प्रासमुग्दरैः spears, वृतः surrounded, भूतैः beings, महेश्वरःइव like Maheswara, भाति seems.

40017211.author: Translation
40017211.content: "Who is he in the midst, with sharp tridents and shining spears, like Maheswara surrounded by beings?"

40017212.author: पदार्थः
40017212.content: यः he who, एषः in that way, कालजिह्वाप्रकाशाभिः gleaming like the tongues of Kala, रथशक्तीभिः with flashes of javelins, आवृतः encircled, विद्युद्भिः lightning, तोयदःइव like a cloud, अतिविराजते shining very bright.

40017212.author: Translation
40017212.content: "Who is he, gleaming like the tongues of time spirit (Kala spirit), with flashes of javelins, encircled with lightning and looking like a cloud shining very bright?"

40017213.author: पदार्थः
40017213.content: सज्जानि all bows, हेमपृष्ठानि with golden backs, धनूंषि च bows, अस्य his, रथश्रेष्ठम् excellent chariot, शक्रचापम् rainbow, अम्बरम् इव in the sky like, सर्वशः all sides, शोभयन्ति beautiful.

40017213.author: Translation
40017213.content: "His bows decorated with gold on the back, are like a rainbow in the sky on all sides and makes the chariot excellent."

40017214.author: पदार्थः
40017214.content: कः he, रक्षश्शार्दूलः tiger among Rakshasas, रथिनाम् on the chariot, श्रेष्ठः foremost, एषः in that way, रणभूमिम् battlefield, विराजयन् illuminating, आदित्यतेजसा like the brightness of the Sun, रथेन on chariot, अभ्येति coming, सूर्यरमशिनभैः resplendent like Sun 's rays, बाणैः by arrows, दश ten, दिशः directions, विराजयन् illuminating, ध्वजशृङ्घप्रतिष्ठेन on top of the pole of the chariot, राहुणा by the Rahu, अभिविराजते very splendid.

40017214.author: Translation
40017214.content: "The tiger among the Rakshasas seated in the chariot is the foremost car warrior. He is illuminating the battlefield like the brightness of the Sun, resplendent like Sun 's rays. By his arrows he is illuminating the ten directions. The Rahu emblem on top of the pole of the chariot is very splendid."

40017215.author: पदार्थः
40017215.content: कः he, रक्षश्शार्दूलः tiger among Rakshasas, रथिनाम् on the chariot, श्रेष्ठः foremost, एषः in that way, रणभूमिम् battlefield, विराजयन् illuminating, आदित्यतेजसा like the brightness of the Sun, रथेन on chariot, अभ्येति coming, सूर्यरमशिनभैः resplendent like Sun 's rays, बाणैः by arrows, दश ten, दिशः directions, विराजयन् illuminating, ध्वजशृङ्घप्रतिष्ठेन on top of the pole of the chariot, राहुणा by the Rahu, अभिविराजते very splendid.

40017215.author: Translation
40017215.content: "The tiger among the Rakshasas seated in the chariot is the foremost car warrior. He is illuminating the battlefield like the brightness of the Sun, resplendent like Sun 's rays. By his arrows he is illuminating the ten directions. The Rahu emblem on top of the pole of the chariot is very splendid."

40017216.author: पदार्थः
40017216.content: अस्य his, त्रिणतम् curved in three places, मेघसन्नादम् close to thundering cloud, हेमवृष्ठम् golden, अलङ्कृतम् decorated, धनुः bow, प्रख्यम् casting, विराजते splendour.

40017216.author: Translation
40017216.content: "His bow with three curves, covered with gold, decorated, is close to a thundering cloud, casting its splendour."

40017217.author: पदार्थः
40017217.content: सध्वजः the standard, सपताकश्च and the flag, सानुकर्षः axletree, मेघस्तनितानि emitting sound like the rumblings of cloud, महारथः great chariot, चतुस्सादिसमायुक्तः driven by four charioteers.

40017217.author: Translation
40017217.content: "His chariot with standard, flag and axletree is a great one driven by four charioteers emitting sound like the rumblings of clouds."

40017218.author: पदार्थः
40017218.content: विंशतिः twenty, दश च ten, अष्टौ च eight, तूण्यः quivers, भीमानि frightening, कार्मुकानि च bows, काञ्चनपिङ्गळाः golden coloured, ज्याश्च bowstrings अस्य his, रथम् chariot, आस्थिताः lay arranged.

40017218.author: Translation
40017218.content: "This chariot has twenty quivers, ten frightening bows, and eight bow strings of golden colour lay arranged in the chariot."

40017219.author: पदार्थः
40017219.content: पार्श्वस्थौ on the sides, पार्श्वशोभितौ decorating the sides, चतुर्हस्तत्सरुयुतौ measuring four cubits, व्यक्तहस्तदशायतौ ten cubits long, द्वौ two, घडगौ च swords, रथगतौ decorating it.

40017219.author: Translation
40017219.content: "It has two swords off our cubits and ten cubits long swords provided with hilts hanging on its sides as decoration."

40017220.author: पदार्थः
40017220.content: रक्तकण्ठगुणः wearing red garland s around his neck, धीरः brave, महापर्वतसन्निभः as if he is a mountain, कालः death, कालमहावक्त्रः dark with large mouth, मेघस्थः veiled by cloud, भास्करःइव like Sun.

40017220.author: Translation
40017220.content: "Wearing red garland s round the neck, brave, like a mountain in form, dark with large mouth, like death, like sun veiled by clouds he seems."

40017221.author: पदार्थः
40017221.content: काञ्चनाङ्गदनद्धाभ्याम् by adorning golden armlets, भुजाभ्याम् both arms, एषः that way, तुङ्गाभ्याम् high, शृङ्गाभ्याम् peak, पर्वतोत्तमः like a mountain, हिमवान् इव like Himalaya mountain, शोभते shining.

40017221.author: Translation
40017221.content: "By adorning armlets, his both arms are like high peaks of Himalaya mountain shining away."

40017222.author: पदार्थः
40017222.content: शुभेक्षणम् auspicious eyes, वक्त्रम् countenance, यस्स्वैतध्बाति whose is shining, कुण्डलाभ्याम् both ear rings, पुनर्वस्वन्तरगतः between Punarvasu stars, पूर्णंबिंबमिवैंदवम् like the full moon.

40017222.author: Translation
40017222.content: "He who shines like the full moon between two Punarvasu stars, his auspicious eyes and countenance shines with both earrings."

40017223.author: पदार्थः
40017223.content: महाबाहो mighty armed one, यं him, दृष्टवा seeing, सर्वे all, वानराः Vanara, भयार्ताः fear, दिशः direction, विद्रुताः fled, एनम् such, राक्षसोत्तमम् foremost of the Rakshasas, त्वम् you, मे to me, आचक्ष्व show him.

40017223.author: Translation
40017223.content: "Oh! Vibheeshana, a mighty armed one! Show me that foremost of Rakshasas, whom all Vanaras feared and fled in all directions."

40017224.author: पदार्थः
40017224.content: राजपुत्रेण prince, अमिततेजसा highly brilliant, रामेण by Rama, पृष्टः interrogated, सः he, महातेजाः highly energetic, विभीषणः Vibheeshana, राघवाय to Raghava, आचचक्षे revealed.

40017224.author: Translation
40017224.content: Interrogated by the highly brilliant prince Raghava, energetic Vibheeshana revealed.

40017225.author: पदार्थः
40017225.content: दशग्रीवः tenheaded, महातेजाः highly brilliant, राजा king, वैश्रवणानुजः brother of Vysravana, भीमकर्मा of terrible deeds, महोत्साहः highly exploitative, रावणः Ravana, राक्षसाधिपः king of Rakshasas.

40017225.author: Translation
40017225.content: "The tenheaded and highly brilliant king Ravana, who is the brother of Vysravana, is of terrible deeds and highly exploitative."

40017226.author: पदार्थः
40017226.content: तस्य to him, वीर्यवान् valiant, रणे in war, रावणप्रतिमः compeer of Ravana, वृद्धसेवी served elders, श्रुतिधरः learned, सर्वास्त्रविदुषाम् well versed in all sastras, वरः blessed, पुत्रः son, आसीत् born.

40017226.author: Translation
40017226.content: "To him was born a blessed son, valiant one, compeer of Ravana, who served elders, learned and well versed in sastras."

40017227.author: पदार्थः
40017227.content: अश्वपृष्ठे best in riding on horseback, नागेरथे on elephant, खडगे in the use of sword, सान्त्वे च and bow also, भेदे sowing dissension, दाने च in making charity, नये in making peace, मन्त्रे च in statecraft, सम्मतः capable.

40017227.author: Translation
40017227.content: "He is best in riding on horseback, on elephant back and in the use of sword and bow. He is capable of sowing dissension, making peace, giving charity and statecraft."

40017228.author: पदार्थः
40017228.content: यस्य his, बाहुम् shoulders, समाश्रित्य seeking refuge, लङ्का Lanka, निर्भया fearless, वसति remains, इमम् he is, धान्यमालिन्याः Dhanyamalini's, तनयम् son, अतिकायम् Atikaya, विदुः you may know.

40017228.author: Translation
40017228.content: "He is known as Atikaya, son of Dhanyamalini. Lanka remains fearless on his shoulders, you may know."

40017229.author: पदार्थः
40017229.content: तपसा by penance, भावितात्मना of supreme intellect, एतेन by him, ब्रह्मा Brahma, आराधितः propitiated, अस्त्राणि च mystic missiles, अवाप्तानि presented, रिपवश्च enemies, पराजिताः defeated.

40017229.author: Translation
40017229.content: "By penance on supreme self he propitiated Brahma, who blessed him with mystic missiles by way of boons by which his enemies were subdued."

40017230.author: पदार्थः
40017230.content: स्वयम्भूव selfborn, अस्मै to him, सुरासुरैः gods and demons, अवध्यत्वम् exemption from death, दत्तम् was given, एतत् all this, दिव्यम् wonderful, कवचं च shield, रभास्वरः bright as the Sun, रथश्च chariot.

40017230.author: Translation
40017230.content: "Exemption from death from gods and demons was given to him and all this wonderful shield and chariot as bright as the sun."

40017231.author: पदार्थः
40017231.content: एतेन by this, शतशः hundreds, देवाः Devatas, दानवाश्च Danavas also, पराजिताः defeated, यक्षाश्चा , Yakshas, रक्षितानि च protected,, रक्षांसि Rakshasas, निषूदिताः killed.

40017231.author: Translation
40017231.content: "By this (boon) hundreds of Devatas and demons were defeated by him, Yakshas were killed, nay Rakshasas were protected."

40017232.author: पदार्थः
40017232.content: येन by him, रणे in battle, बाणैः arrows, धीमतः wise, इन्द्रस्य Indra's, वज्रम् thunderbolt, विष्टम्भितम् obstructed firmly, तथा likewise, सलिलराजस्य Varuna's, पाशः noose, प्रतिहतः repelled, एषः in that way, अतिकायः Atikaya, बलवान् strong, अथ now, राक्षसानाम् Rakshasas, र्षभः bull यः he who, धीमान् wise, रावणसुतः Ravana's son, देवदानवदर्पहा subduer of the pride of Devas and Danavas.

40017232.author: Translation
40017232.content: "Here is strong Atikaya, a wise son of Ravana, bull among Rakshasas, who is a subduer of the pride of Devas and Danavas, by whom thunderbolt of Indra was obstructed firmly in battle and likewise the noose of Varuna was repelled in war."

40017233.author: पदार्थः
40017233.content: येन by him, रणे in battle, बाणैः arrows, धीमतः wise, इन्द्रस्य Indra's, वज्रम् thunderbolt, विष्टम्भितम् obstructed firmly, तथा likewise, सलिलराजस्य Varuna's, पाशः noose, प्रतिहतः repelled, एषः in that way, अतिकायः Atikaya, बलवान् strong, अथ now, राक्षसानाम् Rakshasas, र्षभः bull यः he who, धीमान् wise, रावणसुतः Ravana's son, देवदानवदर्पहा subduer of the pride of Devas and Danavas.

40017233.author: Translation
40017233.content: "Here is strong Atikaya, a wise son of Ravana, bull among Rakshasas, who is a subduer of the pride of Devas and Danavas, by whom thunderbolt of Indra was obstructed firmly in battle and likewise the noose of Varuna was repelled in war."

40017234.author: पदार्थः
40017234.content: पुरुषपुङ्गव best of men, तत् therefore, अस्मिन् his, क्षिप्रम् quickly, यत्नः efforts, क्रियताम् be exhibited, वानरसैन्यानि Vanara army, सायकैः by arrows, क्षयंपुरानयति before he puts an end.

40017234.author: Translation
40017234.content: "Oh, best of men! Quickly make efforts to put an end to him before he puts down Vanara army."

40017235.author: पदार्थः
40017235.content: ततः thereafter, बलवान् mighty, अतिकायः Atikaya, हरिवाहिनीम् monkey army, प्रविश्य entered, धनुः bow, विस्फारयामास twanged, पुनःपुनः again and again, ननाद च made loud noise.

40017235.author: Translation
40017235.content: Thereafter, mighty Atikaya entered the monkey army, twanged his bow again and again and made a loud noise.

40017236.author: पदार्थः
40017236.content: अथस्थम् seated, रथिनाम् on the chariot, परम् supreme, भीमवपुषम् dreadful enemy, तम् him, दृष्टवा observing, प्रधानाः foremost, महात्मानः great, ये those, वनौकसः Vanaras, अभिपेतुः rushed towards him.

40017236.author: Translation
40017236.content: Observing the dreadful enemy seated on the chariot, the foremost of the great Vanaras rushed towards him.

40017237.author: पदार्थः
40017237.content: कुमुदः Kumuda, द्विविदः Dwivida, मैन्दः Mainda, नीलः Neela, शरभःएव च even Sarabha, पादपैः with trees, गिरिशृङ्गैःच and mountain peaks, युगपत् assailed समभिद्रवन् all at once.

40017237.author: Translation
40017237.content: Kumuda, Dwivida, Mainda, Neela, even Sarabha, all at once assailed him with trees and mountain peaks.

40017238.author: पदार्थः
40017238.content: महातेजाः endowed with extraordinary energy, अस्त्रविदाम् efficient in use of weapons, वरः foremost, अतिकायः Atikaya, काञ्चनभूषणैः adorned with gold, शरैः arrows, तेषाम् by that, वृक्षान्च trees, शैलान् च and rocks, चिच्छेद shattered.

40017238.author: Translation
40017238.content: Atikaya, endowed with extraordinary energy, efficient in the use of weapons, shattered the trees and rocks hurled by the Vanaras with his arrows adorned with gold.

40017239.author: पदार्थः
40017239.content: बली powerful, भीमकायः of terrible form, निशाचर night anger, सङ्ख्ये in the battlefield, अभिमुखान् facing, तान् them, सर्वान् all, हरीन् monkeys, सर्वायसैः iron, शरैः arrows, विव्याध pierced.

40017239.author: Translation
40017239.content: The powerful night ranger of terrible form, pierced all monkeys who were facing him in the battlefield with iron arrows.

40017240.author: पदार्थः
40017240.content: महारणे great war, अतिकायस्य Atikaya's, बाणवर्णेण by a hail of arrows, अर्दिताः hard pressed, भिन्नगात्राः limbs broken, ते they, प्लवङ्गमाः monkeys, प्रतिकर्तुम् to resist, न शेकुः not possible.

40017240.author: Translation
40017240.content: The monkeys were hard pressed by Atikaya's hail of arrows. Their limbs broke and were unable to resist.

40017241.author: पदार्थः
40017241.content: यौवनदर्पितः lion with youthful pride, राक्षसः Rakshasa, क्रुद्धः enraged, हरिः monkey, मृगयूथमिव group of deer, हरिवीराणाम् monkey heroes, तत् that, सैन्यम् army, त्रासयामास struck.

40017241.author: Translation
40017241.content: Just as a young lion with youthful pride would strike a group of deer, the enraged Rakshasa struck the army of monkey heroes.

40017242.author: पदार्थः
40017242.content: सः he, राक्षसेन्द्रः Rakshasa Lord, हरिसैन्यमध्ये in the midst of monkey army, अयुध्यमानम् wielding weapon, कञ्चित् indeed, निजाघान not strike, सधम: कलापी armed with bow and quiver, सः he, उपेत्य taking, रामम् Rama, गर्वितम् with pride, इदम् this, वाक्यम् words, बभाषे spoke.

40017242.author: Translation
40017242.content: The Rakshasa lord, wielding a weapon in the midst of the monkey army, indeed did not strike any, but armed with bow and quiver went with pride towards Rama and spoke.

40017243.author: पदार्थः
40017243.content: अहम् I, शरचापपाणिः with bow and arrow, रथे chariot, स्थितः seated, प्राकृतम् common warrior, कञ्चन indeed, नयोधयामि not give war, यस्य to him कश्चित् indeed, अस्ति now, व्यवसाययुक्तः whoever is interested, अद्य now इह here, क्षिप्रम् speedily, मे to me, युद्धम् fight, ददातु give me.

40017243.author: Translation
40017243.content: "I am with a bow and arrow seated in the chariot. Indeed, I am not strong in fighting with common warriors. Whoever is interested to fight now can come speedily to fight with me."

40017244.author: पदार्थः
40017244.content: ब्रुवतः having spoken, तस्य his, वाक्यम् that word, निशम्य hearing, अमित्रहन्ता destroyer of enemies, सौमित्रिः Saumithri, चुकोप in anger, ततः then, स्मयित्वा not enduring, अमृष्यमाणः not able to tolerate, समुत्पपात went towards, चापम् sword, जग्राह took up.

40017244.author: Translation
40017244.content: On hearing Atikaya, Saumithri the destroyer of enemies, became angry, not enduring and not able to tolerate went towards him taking a sword.

40017245.author: पदार्थः
40017245.content: क्रुद्धः furious. सौमित्रिः Saumithri, उत्पत्य springing up, तूणात् from quiver, सायकम् arrow, आक्षिप्य stretching, अतिकायस्य full length, पुरस्तात् before, महत् great, धनुः bow, चकर्ष discharged.

40017245.author: Translation
40017245.content: Furious Saumithri, springing up, took up his arrow from the quiver, stretching to full length before he discharged the arrow.

40017246.author: पदार्थः
40017246.content: लक्ष्मणस्य Lakshmana's, सः that, ज्याशब्दः sound of twang, शैलान् mountains, महीम् earth, आकाशम् sky, सागरम् ocean, दिशः directions, पूरयन् filled, रजनीचरान् night ranger, त्रासयन् terror, उग्रः terrible.

40017246.author: Translation
40017246.content: The twang of Lakshmana filled the mountains, earth, ocean, and all directions striking terrible fear in the night ranger.

40017247.author: पदार्थः
40017247.content: तदा then, बली powerful, महातेजाः extraordinary energetic, राक्षसेन्द्रात्मजः Rakshasa king's son, प्रतिभयम् in turn frightened, सौमित्रेः Saumithri's, चापनिर्घोषम् sound of his bow, श्रुत्वा hearing, विसिष्मिये astonished.

40017247.author: Translation
40017247.content: Then the extraordinarily energetic and powerful son of Rakshasa king was in turn frightened at the sound of Saumithri's bow and was astonished.

40017248.author: पदार्थः
40017248.content: अथा and then, उत्थितम् sprang up, लक्ष्मणम् Lakshmana, दृष्टवा seeing, अतिकायः Atikaya, कुपितः angry, निशितम् sharp, बाणम् shaft, आदाय taking, इदंवचनम् these words, अब्रवीत् spoke.

40017248.author: Translation
40017248.content: Seeing Atikaya, furious Lakshmana sprang up and took a sharp shaft and spoke as follows.

40017249.author: पदार्थः
40017249.content: सौमित्रे O! Saumithri, त्वम् you, विक्रमेषु are valiant, अविचक्षणः not discriminative, असि are, बालः young, कालसदृशम् equal to death, माम् I am, योधयितुम् to combat with, किम् why, इच्छसि do you desire.

40017249.author: Translation
40017249.content: "O Saumithri! You are valiant but young, not able to discriminate. I am equal to the Lord of death. Why do you desire to comb at with me?"

40017250.author: पदार्थः
40017250.content: मद्बाहुसृष्टानाम् discharged by my arm, आस्त्राणाम् shafts, वेगम् speed, हिमनानपि even Himalayas, सोढुम् force, न उत्सहतेहि not able to bear, अन्तरिक्षम् sky, अथो on the other hand, मही earth.

40017250.author: Translation
40017250.content: The shafts discharged from my arm can't be borne, by the Himalayas, even the atmosphere between the sky and earth can't bear the force.

40017251.author: पदार्थः
40017251.content: सुखप्रसुप्तम् sleeping comfortably, कालाग्निम् fire of dissolution, विबोधयितुम् why do you arouse, इच्छसि desire, चापम् bow, न्यस्य casting away, निवर्तस्व return back, मद्गतः confronting me प्राणान् life, माजहि go away.

40017251.author: Translation
40017251.content: "Why do you want to arouse the fire of dissolution sleeping comfortably? Return, casting away your bow, without confronting. Go away."

40017252.author: पदार्थः
40017252.content: अथवा or else, त्वम् you, प्रतिष्टब्धः you want to oppose, निवर्तितुम् to return, न इच्छसि not wish, तिष्ठ stay, प्राणान् life, परित्यज्य giving up, यमक्ष्यम् Yama's abode, गमिष्यसि proceed.

40017252.author: Translation
40017252.content: "Or else if you want to oppose and not return, give up your life and proceed to Yama's abode."

40017253.author: पदार्थः
40017253.content: मे my, नरिदर्पनिषूदनान् capable of reducing the ride of enemy, ईश्वरायुधसङ्काशान् like the Ishwara's trident, तप्तकाञ्चनभूषणान् ornamented with polished gold, निशितान् sharp, बाणान् shafts, पश्य see.

40017253.author: Translation
40017253.content: "See my sharp shafts capable of reducing enemy's pride like Ishwara's trident, ornamented with polished gold."

40017254.author: पदार्थः
40017254.content: सर्पसंकाशः like serpents, एषःबाणाः these arrows, क्रुद्धः angry, मृगराजः lion, नागराजस्य elephant's, शोणितम् blood, ते to you, शोणितम् blood, पास्यति drink, इत्येवम् therefore, उक्त्वा told, संक्रुद्धः furious, शरम् arrow, धनुषि bow, संदधे fixed.

40017254.author: Translation
40017254.content: "These arrows are like serpents and can drink your blood just as an angry lion drinks the blood of elephants. Therefore, I tell you", said Atikaya to Lakshmana."

40017255.author: पदार्थः
40017255.content: राजपुत्रः prince, सम्यति fitted, अतिकायस्य Atikaya, सरोषम् in wrath, सगर्वितम् proud, वचः utterance, श्रुत्वा hearing, सञ्चुकोप enraged, अतिबलः very strong, मनस्वी high minded, महार्थम् great meaning, सः he, ततः those, वाक्यम् words, उवाच spoke.

40017255.author: Translation
40017255.content: Prince Atikaya, having spoken as said before, fitted his bow in wrath. Hearing the proud statement of Atikaya, the highminded Lakshmana, endowed with strength, enraged, and spoke these words of great meaning.

40017256.author: पदार्थः
40017256.content: दुरात्मन् evil minded, भवान् you are, वाक्यमात्रेण by mere statement, प्रधानः chief, न not, कत्थनात् speech, सत्पुरुषाः good people, न भवन्ति not do, धन्विनि bow, बाणपाणौ armed with a bow, स्थिते stand, मयि my, आत्मबलम् your strength, निदर्शयस्य prove.

40017256.author: Translation
40017256.content: "You are evil minded. By mere statement you people can't become good chiefs. I stand armed with a bow and arrow. Prove your strength."

40017257.author: पदार्थः
40017257.content: कर्मणा by action, आत्मानम् yourself, सूचय indicated, विकत्थितुम् reveal, न अर्हसि not deserve, यः he who, पौरुषेण with prowess, युक्तः right, सः he, शूरःइति is a hero, स्मृतः are known as.

40017257.author: Translation
40017257.content: "Reveal yourself by action not by indication. You do not deserve it. He who is with prowess is a right hero."

40017258.author: पदार्थः
40017258.content: त्वम् you, धन्वी bow, सर्वायुधसमायुक्तः collecting all kinds of weapons, रथम् chariot, आस्थितः seated, शरैःवा with arrows, यदिवापि by that alone, अस्त्रै: weapons, पराक्रमम् capable, दर्शयस्य show.

40017258.author: Translation
40017258.content: "You are seated in the chariot with all kinds of weapons collected. By that alone you do not become capable. Show your capacity."

40017259.author: पदार्थः
40017259.content: ततः then, अहम् I, निशितैः sharp, शरैः arrows, तेशिरः his head, मारुतः wind, कालसम्पक्वम् in the process of time when ripened, ताळफलम् palm fruit, वृन्तात् यथा drops, पातयिष्यामि will throw.

40017259.author: Translation
40017259.content: "Then I will strike down his head with sharp arrows and throw him just as ripened palm fruit drops in the process of time."

40017260.author: पदार्थः
40017260.content: अद्य now, तप्तकाञ्चनभूषणाः decked with polished gold, मामकाः my बाणाः arrows, तेगात्रात् from your neck, बाणशल्यान्तरोत्थितम् by the holes made by pointed arrows, रुधिरम् blood, पास्यन्ति will drink.

40017260.author: Translation
40017260.content: "Now, you will drink the blood ejected from your neck by the holes made with my pointed arrows decked with polished gold."

40017261.author: पदार्थः
40017261.content: अयम् this, बालः young, इति thus, विज्ञाय victory, अवज्ञातुम् underestimate, न च अर्हसि not know, बालोवा being young, वृद्धोवा or old, संयुगे in battle, मृत्युम् death, जानीहि not know, बालेन by being young, विष्णुवा Vishnu, त्रिविक्रमैः Trivikrama, त्रयः three, लोकाः worlds, क्रान्ताः going.

40017261.author: Translation
40017261.content: "You should not underestimate me thinking I am young or old to win. You do not know that I am spirit of death in battle. Did not Vishnu as young Trivikrama win the three worlds going by three strides?"

40017262.author: पदार्थः
40017262.content: लक्ष्मणस्य Lakshmana's, हेतुमत् reasoning, परमार्थवत् full of truth, वचः words, श्रुत्वा hearing, अतिकायः Atikaya, प्रचुक्रोध very furious, उत्तमम् best of, बाणम् arrows, आददे च took.

40017262.author: Translation
40017262.content: On hearing the words of Lakshmana, which was reasonable and full of truth, Atikaya became furious and took up the best of arrows.

40017263.author: पदार्थः
40017263.content: ततः then, विद्याधराः Vidhyadhara, भूताः Demons, देवाः Devas, दैत्याः Daityas, महर्षयः Sages, महात्मानः great people, गुह्यकाः च Guhyakas, तदा then, तत् there, युद्धम् battlefield, द्रष्टुमागमन् arrived to witness.

40017263.author: Translation
40017263.content: Then vidhyadharas, demons, devatas, daityas, sages and great guhyakas arrived at the battlefield to witness.

40017264.author: पदार्थः
40017264.content: ततः then, अतिकायः Atikaya, कुपितः enraged, सायकम् arrows, चापम् to bow, आरोप्य fixing, अम्बरम् sky, सङ्क्षिपम् इव as if discharging it in the sky, लक्ष्मणाय at Lakshmana, प्रचिक्षेप directed.

40017264.author: Translation
40017264.content: Then enraged Atikaya, fixing his arrow to the bow as if discharging it in the sky directed at Lakshmana.

40017265.author: पदार्थः
40017265.content: परवीरहा heroic destroyer of enemies, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, आपतन्तम् coming towards, आशीविषोपमम् venomous serpent like arrow, निशितम् sharp, तंशरम् that arrow, अर्धचन्द्रेण half moon shaped, चिच्छेद shattered.

40017265.author: Translation
40017265.content: Lakshmana, the heroic destroyer of enemies, shattered the venomous serpent like arrow with his sharp half moon shaped arrow.

40017266.author: पदार्थः
40017266.content: अतिकायः Atikaya, कृत्तभोगम् torn asunder, उरगम् इव like serpent, निकृत्तम् offended, तंशरम् that arrow, दृष्टवा seeing, भृशम् , क्रुद्धः angry, पञ्च five, बाणान् arrows, समाददे fitted.

40017266.author: Translation
40017266.content: Seeing the arrow torn asunder like a serpent, Atikaya was offended and became very angry and fitted five arrows to his bow.

40017267.author: पदार्थः
40017267.content: निशाचरः night ranger, तान् शरान् those arrows, लक्ष्मणाय at Lakshmana, सम्प्रचिक्षेप loosed with force, भरतानुजः Bharata's brother, तान् them, अप्राप्तान् before reaching, शरैः arrows, तीक्ष्णैः sharp, चिच्छेद shattered.

40017267.author: Translation
40017267.content: The night ranger set loose those arrows at Lakshmana, Bharata's brother. Lakshmana shattered them even before it reached him.

40017268.author: पदार्थः
40017268.content: परवीरहा heroic destroyer of foes, सःलक्ष्मणः that Lakshmana, तान् them, शितैः sharp, बाणैः arrows, छित्त्वा split, तेजसा bright, ज्वलन्तमि flaming, निशितम् sharp, बाणम् arrow, आददे seized.

40017268.author: Translation
40017268.content: Lakshmana, the heroic destroyer of foes, having split those arrows, seized a shaft which was a bright and sharp flaming arrow.

40017269.author: पदार्थः
40017269.content: लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, वीर्यवान् valiant, धनुश्श्रेष्ठे foremost of the wielders of bow, योजयामास stretching, वेगेन quickly, विचकर्ष च till the ear, विससर्ज च discharged.

40017269.author: Translation
40017269.content: Valiant Lakshmana, foremost of the wielders of bow stretching his bow till the ear, quickly discharged the arrow.

40017270.author: पदार्थः
40017270.content: वीर्यवान heroic, सः he, पूर्णायतविसृषेन fully stretching, नतपर्वणा bending to curvature, शरेण the arrow, राक्षसश्रेष्ठम् foremost of the Rakshasas, ललाटे forehead, आजघान struck.

40017270.author: Translation
40017270.content: The heroic Lakshmana fully stretching the arrow bending to curvature struck Atikaya, the foremost of Rakshasas on his forehead.

40017271.author: पदार्थः
40017271.content: भीमस्य terrific, तस्यरक्षसः that Rakshasa, ललाटे forehead, मग्नः stuck on top, अक्तः said, सः he, शरः arrow, अचले mountain, पन्नगेन्द्रःइव like serpent, ददृशे seemed.

40017271.author: Translation
40017271.content: That arrow stuck on the forehead of the terrific Rakshasa looked like a serpent on a mountain.

40017272.author: पदार्थः
40017272.content: अथ now, लक्ष्मणेषुप्रपीडितः tormented by Lakshmana's arrow, राक्षसः Rakshasa, रुद्रबाणहतम् as though struck by arrow of Rudra, घोरम् dreadful, त्रिपुरगोपुरंयथा like the gate of Tripura, प्रचकम्पे shaken.

40017272.author: Translation
40017272.content: Now tormented by Lakshmana's arrow the Rakshasa was shaken dreadfully like the gate of Tripura (the city built of gold, silver, and iron in heaven, in space and earth by Maya and burnt by Rudra).

40017273.author: पदार्थः
40017273.content: महाबलः extra ordinary mighty, आश्वास्य recovering, विमृश्य reflecting, चिन्तयामास contemplated, साधु course of action, बाणनिपातेन releasing the arrow, मे me, श्लाघनीयः worthy of praise, रिपुः enemy, असि you are.

40017273.author: Translation
40017273.content: Recovering from the hurt and reflecting, the Rakshasa contemplated the course of action, and said 'By releasing the arrow on me you are an enemy worthy of praise."

40017274.author: पदार्थः
40017274.content: एवम् in that way, विधाय knowing, आस्यम् face, विनम्य bending, भुजावुभौ both shoulders, नियम्य च setting right, सः he, रथोपस्थम् on the rear of the chariot, आस्थाय settled, रथेन from chariot, प्रचचार ह started to move.

40017274.author: Translation
40017274.content: Having spoken that way bending his face setting both shoulders right, he settled at the rear end of the chariot started to move from the chariot.

40017275.author: पदार्थः
40017275.content: राक्षसर्षभः bull among Rakshasas, एकम् one, त्रीन् three, पञ्च five, सप्तेति seven, सायकान् arrows, आददे taking, सन्दधेचापि fixing to the bow, विचकर्ष stretching, उत्ससर्जच and released.

40017275.author: Translation
40017275.content: The bull among the Rakshasas taking, one, three, five and seven arrows, fixing them to the bow stretching released.

40017276.author: पदार्थः
40017276.content: राक्षसेन्द्रधनुश्च्युताः arrows released from Rakshasa's bow, कालसङ्काशाः like the spirit of time, हेमपुङ्खाः with gold feathered, रविप्रख्याः shone like the Sun, ते they, अम्बरम् sky, दीप्तम् इव glowing like, चक्रुः made.

40017276.author: Translation
40017276.content: The gold feathered arrows released from the rakshasas's bow, were like death arrows which shone in the sky as if the sky was glowing.

40017277.author: पदार्थः
40017277.content: ततः then, राघवानुजः Raghava's brother, राक्षसोत्सत्सृष्टान् released by the Rakshasa, तान् them, शरौघान् volley of arrows, असंभ्रान्तः unconfounded, निशितैः sharp, बहुभिः many, शरैः arrows, प्रचिच्छेद shattered.

40017277.author: Translation
40017277.content: Raghava's brother remained unconfounded and then he shattered the volley of many sharp arrows released by the Rakshasa.

40017278.author: पदार्थः
40017278.content: त्रिदशेन्द्रारि Enemy of Indra, रावणात्मजः Ravana's son, युधि in battle, निकृत्तान् ineffective, तान् शरान् all kinds of arrows, सम्प्रेक्ष्य observing चुपोप angry, निशितम् sharp, शरम् arrow, जग्राह took up.

40017278.author: Translation
40017278.content: Ravana's son, an enemy of Indra, observing that all arrows have been ineffective, took up another sharp arrow.

40017279.author: पदार्थः
40017279.content: महातेजाः very energetic, सः he, तम् his, बाणम् arrow, सन्धाय fixing, सहसा forcibly, उत्सृजत् released, तेन by that, आयान्तम् , सौमित्रिम् Saumithri's, स्तनान्तरे between is breast, आजघान pierced.

40017279.author: Translation
40017279.content: Highly energetic Atikaya, fixing another arrow released it between the breasts of Saumithri and pierced.

40017280.author: पदार्थः
40017280.content: युधि in battle, अतिकायेन by Atikaya, वक्षसि chest, ताडितः hurt, सौमित्रिः Saumithri, मत्तः in rut द्विपः elephant, मदम् इव like the fluid, तीव्रम् swiftly, रुधिरम् blood, सुस्राव flowed.

40017280.author: Translation
40017280.content: In the battle, Saumithri was hurt in the chest by Atikaya's arrow and blood flowed like the ichor from elephant in rut.

40017281.author: पदार्थः
40017281.content: विभुः glorious, सः he, तदा then, आत्मानम् stuck in his body, सहसा forcibly, विशल्यम् noble, चकार seized, तीक्षणम् pointed, शरम् arrow, जग्राह removed, अस्त्रेणपि also with mystic spell, सन्दधे च pulled out.

40017281.author: Translation
40017281.content: He (Lakshmana) being glorious and noble himself seized hold of the pointed arrow stuck in his body and removed it with a mystic spell.

40017282.author: पदार्थः
40017282.content: तदा then, आग्नेयेनअस्त्रेण with the missile presided over by fire god, सायकम् arrow, योजयामास concentration of the mind fixed, महात्मनः great self, अस्य his, बाणः arrow, धनुष्य bow.

40017282.author: Translation
40017282.content: Then Lakshmana by concentration of his mind fixed on fire god which presided over the arrow, that great selffixed in his bow glowed.

40017283.author: पदार्थः
40017283.content: अतितेजस्वी highly energetic, अतिकायः Atikaya, सौरम् अस्त्रम् weapon presided over by Sun god, समाददे fixing, भुजङ्गाभम् similar to serpent, हेमपुङ्खम् with gold feathers, तंबाणम् that arrow, तेन by that, अयोजयत् fixed it.

40017283.author: Translation
40017283.content: Highly energetic Atikaya took a serpentlike arrow with gold feathers and charged it by the concentration of his mind on the power of Sun god.

40017284.author: पदार्थः
40017284.content: लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, ज्वलितम् glowing, घोरम् fierce, तत् that, अस्त्रम् missile, आहितम् placed, शरम् arrow, अन्तकः death, कालदण्डमिव like the staff of god of death, अतिकायाय at Atikaya, चिक्षेप shattered.

40017284.author: Translation
40017284.content: Lakshmana placed that fierce, glowing missile looking like the staff of God of death on Atikaya.

40017285.author: पदार्थः
40017285.content: निशाचरः night ranger, आग्नेयास्त्राभिसंयुक्तम् united with the missile of fire god, बाणम् arrow, दृष्टवा seeing, तदा then, सूर्यास्त्रयोजितम् united with the charge of sun god, दीप्तम् glowing, बाणम् arrow, उत्ससर्ज released on him.

40017285.author: Translation
40017285.content: The night ranger, seeing the missile charged with fire god coming towards him, released the glowing arrow charged with the power of Sun god.

40017286.author: पदार्थः
40017286.content: तेजसा effulgent, संप्रदीप्ताग्रौ flaming with fire, तौ those, उभौ two, बाणौ arrows, क्रुद्धौ angry, भुजंगमौइव serpents like, अन्योन्यम् one another, अम्बरे sky, अभिजघ्नतुः struck violently.

40017286.author: Translation
40017286.content: Both the arrows effulgent, flaming with fire, were like angry serpents in the sky striking one another violently.

40017287.author: पदार्थः
40017287.content: तौ those two, अन्योन्यम् one another, विनिर्दह्य burning themselves, पृथिवीतले on the earth surface, पेततुः fallen, निरर्चिषौ with no life, भस्मकृतौ burnt to ashes, शरोत्तमौ best of arrows, न भ्राजेते not shine, दीप्यमानौ glowing, तौ those, उभौ two, महीतले on the ground, न भ्राजेते not.

40017287.author: Translation
40017287.content: Those two burning one another and themselves burning had fallen on the earth surface with no fire. Those two best of arrows though glowing, having fallen on earth did not shine as they ceased to emit flames and had been reduced to ashes.

40017288.author: पदार्थः
40017288.content: तौ those two, अन्योन्यम् one another, विनिर्दह्य burning themselves, पृथिवीतले on the earth surface, पेततुः fallen, निरर्चिषौ with no life, भस्मकृतौ burnt to ashes, शरोत्तमौ best of arrows, न भ्राजेते not shine, दीप्यमानौ glowing, तौ those, उभौ two, महीतले on the ground, न भ्राजेते not.

40017288.author: Translation
40017288.content: Those two burning one another and themselves burning had fallen on the earth surface with no fire. Those two best of arrows though glowing, having fallen on earth did not shine as they ceased to emit flames and had been reduced to ashes.

40017289.author: पदार्थः
40017289.content: ततः then, अतिकायः Atikaya, सङ्कृद्धः seized with anger, त्वाष्ट्रम् Twashta, ऐषीकम् Ishikam, उत्सृजत् discharged, ततः then, वीर्यवान् valiant, सौमित्रिः Saumithri, ऐन्द्रेण presided by Indra, अस्त्रम् arrow, चिच्छेद split.

40017289.author: Translation
40017289.content: Then Atikaya seized with anger discharged Ishikam presided over by Twashta (the architect of gods). Saumithri then split the arrow with one presided by Indra and split Ishikam.

40017290.author: पदार्थः
40017290.content: रुषितः annoyed, रावणात्मजः Son of Ravana, ऐषीकम् Ishikam, निहतम् having been destroyed, दृष्टवा seeing, सङ्कृद्धः enraged, सायकम् arrow, याम्येन of Yama, अस्त्रेण arrow, योजयामास struck.

40017290.author: Translation
40017290.content: Annoyed by his arrow Ishikam being struck, Atikaya, son of Ravana charged Lakshmana's arrow with an arrow presided over by Yama.

40017291.author: पदार्थः
40017291.content: ततः then, निशाचरः night ranger, तत् that, अस्त्रम् arrow, लक्ष्मणाय Lakshmana,चिक्षेप shattered, सःलक्ष्मणः that Lakshmana, तत् that, वायव्येनअस्त्रेण arrow presided by Vayu, निजघान charged.

40017291.author: Translation
40017291.content: Then the night ranger shattered the arrow of Lakshmana and in turn released an arrow presided by Vayu.

40017292.author: पदार्थः
40017292.content: अथ and then, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, सङ्कृद्धः enraged, एनम् it, रावणात्मजम् Ravana's son, तोयदः water, धाराभिःइव rainy cloud, शरधाराभिः showered arrows, अभ्यवर्षत heavy torrents.

40017292.author: Translation
40017292.content: And then enraged Lakshmana covered with water like a rainy cloud would shower with torrents.

40017293.author: पदार्थः
40017293.content: ते those, बाणाः arrows, अतिकायम् Atikaya, समासाद्य on touching, वज्रभूषिते like diamond like body, कवचे covering, भग्नाग्रशल्याः broken his coat of iron nails touching the body, सहसा with force, महीतले on ground, पेतुः fallen.

40017293.author: Translation
40017293.content: On those arrows touching Atikaya's diamond like body, the pointed arrows shattered the coat covering the body and the broken coat of nails had fallen down.

40017294.author: पदार्थः
40017294.content: परवीरहा subduer of enemies, महायशाः of great fame, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, तान् them, मोघान् useless, अभिसम्प्रेक्ष्य looking at them, महेषूणाम् mighty, सहस्रेण thousand, अभ्यवर्षत rained.

40017294.author: Translation
40017294.content: Lakshmana of great fame, subduer of enemy looking at the arrows becoming useless mighty hero released thousand arrows.

40017295.author: पदार्थः
40017295.content: बाणौघैः covered with arrows, वृष्यमाणः showered down, महाबलः mighty, अवध्यकवचः shield that impenetrable, राक्षसः Rakshasa, अतिकायः Atikaya, सङ्ख्ये in battlefield, विव्यथे not felt tormented.

40017295.author: Translation
40017295.content: Though covered with arrows showered on him, mighty Rakshasa Atikaya had an impenetrable shield in the battlefield and could not feel the torment.

40017296.author: पदार्थः
40017296.content: आशीविषाकारम् resembling a poisonous serpent, शरम् arrow, लक्ष्मणाय at Lakshmana, व्यपासृजत् , र्मर्मदेशे vital part, तेनशरेण by that arrow, विद्धः knowing, शत्रुतापनः tormentor of foes, सःसौमित्रिः that Saumithri, मुहूर्तमात्रम् for a short while, निस्संज्ञ lost consciousness, अभवत् became.

40017296.author: Translation
40017296.content: Atikaya released an arrow resembling a poisonous serpent at Lakshmana. Pierced in vital part Saumithri, the tormentor of the enemy lost consciousness for a while.

40017297.author: पदार्थः
40017297.content: ततः then, महाबलः mighty, अरिन्दमः subduer of enemies, संज्ञाम् regaining senses, उपालभ्य getting up, शरवर्षैः rain of arrows, ध्वजस्य chariot pole, उन्मथनम् uplifted, कृत्वा destroying, चतुर्भिः four, सायकोत्तमैः best arrows, सङ्ख्ये in the battlefield, सारथिम् charioteer, हयान् horses, निजघान struck down.

40017297.author: Translation
40017297.content: Then mighty subduer of enemies, regaining senses, getting up destroyed the chariot pole with rain of arrows. Taking up four best arrows he struck down the chariot, charioteer, and the horses.

40017298.author: पदार्थः
40017298.content: ततः then, महाबलः mighty, अरिन्दमः subduer of enemies, संज्ञाम् regaining senses, उपालभ्य getting up, शरवर्षैः rain of arrows, ध्वजस्य chariot pole, उन्मथनम् uplifted, कृत्वा destroying, चतुर्भिः four, सायकोत्तमैः best arrows, सङ्ख्ये in the battlefield, सारथिम् charioteer, हयान् horses, निजघान struck down.

40017298.author: Translation
40017298.content: Then mighty subduer of enemies, regaining senses, getting up destroyed the chariot pole with rain of arrows. Taking up four best arrows he struck down the chariot, charioteer, and the horses.

40017299.author: पदार्थः
40017299.content: सौमित्रिः Saumithri, सःलक्ष्मणः that Lakshmana, असम्भ्रान्तः inflict injury, अभिलक्षितान् desiring, तान् शरान् those arrows, तस्यरक्षसः of that Rakshasa, वधार्थम् for killing, मुमोच wishing.

40017299.author: Translation
40017299.content: Saumithri, son of Sumithra, was not able to inflict injury on that Rakshasa with those arrows, though desiring to kill him.

40017300.author: पदार्थः
40017300.content: नरोत्तमः best of men, युधि in battle, रुजम् to injure, कर्तुम् to do, न शशाक not be killed, अथ now, वायुः Vayu, एनम् in that way, उपागम्य having come, वाक्यम् words, उवाच ह spoke to him.

40017300.author: Translation
40017300.content: Wind god (Vayu) having come to the best of men, Lakshmana, spoke to him that in battle it is not possible to injure him or kill him.

40017301.author: पदार्थः
40017301.content: ब्रह्मदत्तवरः by the boon given by Brahma, एषः in that way, अवध्यकवचावृतः covered by armour which can't be broken, एनम् therefore, ब्राह्मेणअस्त्रेण by Brahma's weapon, भिधनि strike, एषः because, अन्यथा other, वध्यः to kill, न not, कवची armour, बली strong, एषः in that way, अन्येषाम् with any other, अस्त्राणाम् by other weapon, अवध्यः not possible to kill.

40017301.author: Translation
40017301.content: By the boon given by Brahma his body is covered with armour which can't be broken. By Brahma's weapon only you can strike to kill him because of his armour and might. By any other weapon it is not possible to kill him.

40017302.author: पदार्थः
40017302.content: ततः then, इन्द्रप्रतिमानवीर्यः equal to Indra in valiance, सौमित्रिः Saumithri, वायोः Wind god, वचनम् words, निशम्य hearing, अथ now, तत् that, ब्राह्मम् अस्त्रम् pressing Brahma weapon to serve, सहसा with force नियोज्य charged, आमोघवेगम् terrific speed, बाणम् arrow, समादधे went, तस्मिन् वरास्त्रेतु while being fixed into the arrows.

40017302.author: Translation
40017302.content: Then Saumithri who is equal to Indra hearing wind god's words invoked Brahma's weapon into service. While he was charging into his arrows and fixing the arrow went at terrific speed.

40017303.author: पदार्थः
40017303.content: सौमित्रिणआ Saumithri, शिताग्रे sharp pointed tip, बाणवरे best, तस्मिन् that, वरास्त्रे foremost arrow नियुज्यमाने charged, दिशः च directions, चन्द्रार्कमहाग्रहाश्च moon and Sun and other planets, नभश्च sky, तत्रास feared, ऊर्वीच earth, चचाल shook.

40017303.author: Translation
40017303.content: As Saumithri charged the sharp pointed foremost arrow, the directions, moon, Sun and other planets and the sky, earth, and all space shook.

40017304.author: पदार्थः
40017304.content: सौमित्रिः Saumithri, सुपुङ्खम् golden feathered, यमदूतकल्पम् like the messenger of death, तंशरम् that arrow, चापे shaft, ब्रह्मणःअस्त्रेण by the Brahma's arrow, नियुज्य charged, वज्रकल्पम् like thunderbolt, बाणम् arrow, तस्य its, अन्द्रारिसुतस्य son of Indra's enemy, ससर्ज released.

40017304.author: Translation
40017304.content: Golden feathered arrow, which resembled thunderbolt, was released on Atikaya, enemy of Indra for whom it was like a messenger of death. It was charged with Brahma's mystic by Saumithri and released on fixing it.

40017305.author: पदार्थः
40017305.content: तदा then, लक्ष्मणोत्सृष्टममोघवेगम् which possessed the velocity of wind, ज्वलनप्रकाशम् emitting sparks, सुपर्णवज्रोत्तमचित्रपुङ्खम् feathers resembling wings of Garuda, समापतन्तम् coming at speed, तम् those, अतिकायः Atikaya, समरे in battle, ददर्श saw.

40017305.author: Translation
40017305.content: Atikaya saw the arrow of Lakshmana coming at a speed, which possessed the velocity of the wind, fixed with feathers resembling the wings of Garuda in the battle.

40017306.author: पदार्थः
40017306.content: अतिकायः Atikaya, तम् those, प्रेक्षमाणंसहसा as he was looking, अनेकैः many, निशितैः sharp, बाणैः arrows, जघान moving, सुपर्णवेगः at the speed of Garuda, तस्य its, सःसायकः that, तथा like that, अतिकायस्य towards Atikaya, पार्श्वम् side, जगाम reached.

40017306.author: Translation
40017306.content: As Atikaya was looking at the arrow, Lakshmana struck many arrows forcibly with sharp arrows possessing the speed of Garuda. The arrows reached towards Atikaya.

40017307.author: पदार्थः
40017307.content: तदा then, अतिकायः Atikaya, प्रदीप्तान्तककालकल्पम् glowing like the spirit of death, आगतम् coming, तंबाणम् that arrow, प्रेक्ष्य perceiving, अविसन्नचेता with unceasing effort, शक्त्यृष्टिगदाकुठारैः javelins, spears, maces, axes, शूलैः tridents, शरैश्चापि and arrows, जघान struck.

40017307.author: Translation
40017307.content: Perceiving the glowing arrow coming, like the spirit of death, Atikaya struck it with unceasing effort with javelins, spears, maces, axes, tridents and even arrows.

40017308.author: पदार्थः
40017308.content: ततो that, अग्निदीप्तः glowing like fire, सःशरः those arrows, अद्भुतविग्रहाणि wonderful shapes, तानि them, आयुधानि weapons, मोघानि unsuccessful, कृत्वा becoming, तस्य its, अतिकायस्य Atikaya's, किरीटजुष्टम् decked with crown, शिरः head, प्रगृह्य seizing, जहार severed.

40017308.author: Translation
40017308.content: This great arrow of Lakshmana glowing like fire rendered the weapons in wonderful shapes released by Atikaya unsuccessful and severed the head of Atikaya decked with a crown.

40017309.author: पदार्थः
40017309.content: लक्ष्मणेषुप्रपीडितम् struck by Lakshmana's arrow, सशिरस्त्राणम् decked with crown, तत् that, शिरः head, हिमवतः like Himalaya, शृङ्गंयथा peak like, सहसा forcibly, भूमौ on ground, पपात fell.

40017309.author: Translation
40017309.content: Struck by Lakshmana's arrow, the crowned head of Atikaya fell on the ground like Himalaya peak.

40017310.author: पदार्थः
40017310.content: हतशेषाः leftover not killed, सर्वे all, निशाचराः Rakshasas, भूमौ on the ground, पतितम् fallen, विक्षिप्तभूषणम् ornaments broken and scattered, दृष्टवा perceiving, व्यथिताः distressed, बभूवुः felt.

40017310.author: Translation
40017310.content: All the Rakshasas who escaped from killing, felt distressed seeing the king and his ornaments scattered on the ground.

40017311.author: पदार्थः
40017311.content: प्रहारजनितश्रमाः pride hurt sorrowful, विषण्णमुखाः desperate looks, दीनांबहवः very sad, ते they, सहसा , विस्वरैः discordant tones, स्वरैः voice, उच्चैः burst into, विनेदुः roared.

40017311.author: Translation
40017311.content: All the Rakshasas with desperate looks, their pride hurt, became very sad and burst into discordant tones roared aloud.

40017312.author: पदार्थः
40017312.content: नायके leader, हते killed, ततः then, निशाचराः night rangers, भीताः afraid, निरपेक्षाः listless, पुरीम् city, अभिमुखाः towards, द्रवन्तः ran, तेत्वरितम् quickly, याताः from there.

40017312.author: Translation
40017312.content: With Leader killed, the night rangers were afraid. Listless they ran quickly towards Lanka.

40017313.author: पदार्थः
40017313.content: भीमबले terrible might, दुरासदे difficult to approach, रिपौ enemy, हते killed, तदा the, बहवः many, वानराः Vanaras, प्रहर्षयुक्ताः extremely delighted, प्रबुद्दपद्मप्रतिमाननाः whose faces were like lotuses in bloom, इष्टभागिनम् filled with joy, लक्ष्मणम् Lakshmana, अपूजयन् worshipped.

40017313.author: Translation
40017313.content: Enemy who was difficult to approach and of terrible might being killed, the Vanaras were extremely delighted. Their faces looked like lotuses in bloom. Filled with joy they worshipped Lakshmana.
